notes: Starting cards as marked: the Objective (posted 'Hidden Base/Can't Probe If It's Not Flipped', dested Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers), 'Indicator', Rendezvous Point and Heading For The Medical Frigate, plus the Effects marked '(SE)' (Wise Advice, Strike Planning, Squadron Assignments). Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. Total 60 as published.

'Indicator (Starting)' is the face-down planet system the Hidden Base objective places from outside the deck to mark the Hidden Base; the post does not name the system, so it is shown as posted (UNKNOWN) and left out of GEMP.

Posted 'Gold Squadron 1 (DSII Falcon, if I got the name wrong)' dested Gold Squadron 1 (it is the Death Star II Falcon); 'Falcon' Millennium Falcon; 'Artoo in Ship' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Gen Lando' General Calrissian; 'Luke w/ knife' / 'Obi w/ knife' Luke With Lightsaber / Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Han w/ gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Leia w/ gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Numb Nuts' Nien Nunb; 'Figrin' Figrin D'an; plain 'Wedge' Wedge Antilles.

'Insight' dested the Death Star II Effect Your Insight Serves You Well (the strategy says 'Start Insight instead of Wise Advice'); 'OMDH' Our Most Desperate Hour; 'WAYTTPOU' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Honor' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Tunnel' Tunnel Vision; 'Signal' The Signal; 'Chandrilla' Chandrila; 'Swamp' is the Special Edition system. Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect in 2000.
The post's updates (Rogue 1, KFC or Premiere Luke may come in; Tawss Khaa may leave; Alter as the 61st card; Liberty might become Tantive IV) are not applied; dested as posted.
